rationale: mint has no single canonical entry point of its own beyond run-mint-batch.mjs (Wave MH-5), and its entry here is what that script imports back. The Gate-A scanner and matcher are the single source, imported directly since lane DEAD-EXEC (2026-09-04) deleted the two scripts/mint/lib/ re-export shims (gate-a-scan.mjs and gate-a-match.mjs) that used to sit in front of them: those shims were pure export-from pass-throughs with no logic of their own, and their only production importer (validate-mint-payload.mjs) and their one test importer (record-facts.npmtest.mjs) now both import src/lib/agent/gate-a-scan.mjs and gate-a-match.mjs directly, so the set of content this family hashes is unchanged, only the two now-redundant shim paths were removed from the list.
